notes.title: Updated on October 11 - 0.9.17
notes.content:
[b]Fixed:[/b]
1. Image Generation - Dynamic Pointer - Operation - Batch Adding Images - The order of adding images continuously is incorrect
﻿
[b]Newly Added:[/b]
1. Image Generation - Static Pointer - Now supports CUR format files
2. Image Generation - Dynamic Pointer - Now supports ANI format files and APNG format files
3. Create Pointer/Modify Pointer - Added a picture of the pointer status (to avoid upload errors when uploading pointers)
4. Create Pointer/Modify Pointer - Added automatic generation of preview images (static preview images can be generated based on the currently uploaded pointers)
5. More friendly error prompts
